text:
Priya (oncall): :rotating_light: Pager: sudden spike in 502/504s at API gateway. 5m error rate ~7.9% (baseline 0.5%). Affected: /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Pager: https://pager.example/INC-2025-042
PagerBot: Incident created INC-2025-042 · severity: high · paging oncall Priya · runbook: https://runbooks/internal/apigw-502s
Jorge: taking first-pass triage. I’m pulling edge proxy logs and LB metrics now.
Nate: I’ll start traffic policy checks and prep a fallback route to us-west-2.
Emily: any recent deploys to ingress in the last hour? I’m checking deploys.
Seong: running quick health checks on upstream inference cluster and mux.
Priya (oncall): no deploys in past 30m from the CD pipeline. first suspicion: sudden backend errors or connection thrash.
Jorge: logs show a surge of "upstream reset" / "connection refused" from upstream pool between 1749876400-1749876500.
Jorge: snippet: ```
ERROR 2025-07-14T12:08:23Z upstream: connection reset by peer /service/inference/session.go:412
HTTP 502 -- returned to client
```
Seong: I see increased 502s on mux nodes -> upstream (inference-pool-a). TCP retransmits high. Suggest connection pool exhaustion.
Nate: rolling traffic to fallback: `infra route set apigw --fallback-region us-west-2 --percent 30`
Emily: quick command to freeze new edge config while we assess: `cd infra && infractl deploy freeze --service=ingress-gateway`
Alex (support): logged a note to customers in status page (incidents.redwood.com/INC-2025-042). ETA message being prepared.
Priya (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) divert 30% traffic to fallback region, 2) bump proxy keepalive & connection pool, 3) enable circuit-breaker on failing upstream, 4) monitor error rate and latency.
Jorge: applied circuit-breaker for inference-pool-a: `kubectl -n infra patch svc inference-pool-a -p '{"spec":{"sessionAffinity":"None"}}'` (applied)
Seong: bumped upstream keepalive and conn pool on mux group: `kubectl -n mux set env deploy/mux PROXY_KEEPALIVE=300 POOL_MAX=120` -> rolling restart started.
Nate: traffic shift executed; now at 30% fallback. `infractl route get apigw` shows fallback in effect.
Priya (oncall): monitoring: live chart: error rate dropping?
Jorge: initial drop to ~4.5% after circuit-breaker and traffic shift. Backend 502s still present but reduced.
Emily: confirm no recent config rollouts — CD pipeline logs empty.
Seong: checking upstream logs for repeated stack traces. Found one obvious client: `inference-worker-42` reporting `dial tcp: i/o timeout` repeatedly -> looks like resource saturation.
Priya (oncall): temp mitigation sufficient to keep customer impact manageable. Customer support: prepare customer-facing blurb: short note + mitigation steps + ETA for follow-up.
Alex (support): drafting: "We saw elevated 502/504 errors affecting generation endpoints. We've routed traffic to fallback region and applied mitigations. Error rate is decreasing. We will follow up with a root-cause update." Will post to status in 5.
Jorge: metrics: 1749876600 -> error rate 4.2%, 1749876700 -> 1.3%.
Seong: mux restarts finished; health checks green.
Nate: increased fallback to 45% to accelerate stabilization. Doing a controlled bump. `infra route set apigw --fallback-region us-west-2 --percent 45`
Priya (oncall): good. keep an eye on latency spikes. avoid full shift until we confirm upstream stability.
Jorge: noticed a related spike in upstream connection queue lengths; opened an alert on that metric for postmortem.
Seong: collected traces and a small sample of 502 stack traces, uploaded to S3: s3://incidents/INC-2025-042/traces.tar.gz
Priya (oncall): status update to channel: error rate trending down, mitigation in place, partial fallback active, support message queued.
PagerBot: Incident severity -> mitigated (degraded). Auto-reminder in 1h for postmortem.
Emily: double-checking whether any recently updated NLB target group settings could cause TCP timeouts. ACLs look fine.
Alex (support): status page updated: https://status.redwood.com/INC-2025-042 — message posted.
Priya (oncall): final numbers: last 5m error rate 1.1% at 1749877100. Requesting handoff: I’ll keep incident open for 15m for stabilization, then handoff to Jorge for RCA and postmortem.
Jorge: taking postmortem owner. Will assemble timeline, relevant metrics, and action items (increase connection pool defaults, refine circuit-breaker thresholds, add better upstream saturation alerts).
Seong: creating a follow-up runbook patch for mux keepalive defaults and a checklist to run when upstream errors spike.
Priya (oncall): closing pager in 10.
Alex (support): will send proactive note to impacted customers with current mitigation and next steps.
Emily: thumbs up. Anything else?
Priya (oncall): thanks team — nice coordination. Closing with a short retro tomorrow. :thumbsup:
